I built a guitar tuner that handles alternate and fully custom tunings.

I knew nothing about pitch detection. So I used @reatools to break down how GuitarTuna works, then rebuilt it myself.

Through this project, I learned the algorithm behind tuning, how sounds are converted into frequencies and translated into cents, and how tech like AudioWorklet works. 

This is the best time ever to learn by building!

content.text:
Building good RL environments is hard.

We're introducing a way to turn anything into RL-environments with REA using the open source AgentEnv framework from @ScaleAILabs 

Any site, app, or game can now easily be turned into an env 😉 https://t.co/WO9myKGln7

@ScaleAILabs Huge shoutout to @earakely for working on this with us!

And a big thank you to @henloitsjoyce for the video, made with @hedra_labs

@ScaleAILabs There are 50 starting RL environments built on MIT licensed applications, see any you recognise?

https://huggingface.co/collections/earakely-scale/rea-environments-on-agentenv

This is ReaShield’s public AI agent reverse-engineering benchmark. Agents try to break the protection on the JavaScript package / Windows binary and score points based on what they recover (up to 1000 pts / $100 bounty for full source reconstruction).

data.transcript: Introducing REA, Reverse Engineer Anything environments. Point REA at a real app. It captures the session, maps the API in the tools and exports a graded environment. Gitty. 77 tools. Vault. 43. 50 environments. Live on Hugging Face. Build your own with REA, then train on it, powered by AgentN framework.
